image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a wet, rocky substrate. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates embedded in a textured, leathery girdle. The plates are brownish-grey with visible growth lines and segmentation. The surrounding environment consists of wet, coarse-grained rock or sand.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates are surrounded by a thick, textured mantle (girdle) that appears leathery and granular, embedding the edges of the plates.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates exhibit a mottled brown and grey coloration with lighter striations, fitting the natural variation described.

Natural depth-of-field blur is present, but some areas show slight inconsistency in focus fall-off, typical of AI generation mimicking macro lenses.

Texture distinction between calcareous plates and leathery girdle
Adherence of the organism to the rocky substrate (no floating)
